name: elysium-mainnet-gloak
_records: What deploy-v2-factory.mjs and deploy-partner.mjs wrote on mainnet: the factory, hook and token deployer (its door belongs to the owner wallet), and the launch vault, router, batch rounds and private bids that make GLOAK's private zone.
admin: FILL IN: the owner wallet. GLOAK's admin, and the only key that can use the door (once).

launch._supply: 500,000 GLOAK, no team share: 295,000 for sale, 205,000 to pair with HYPE in the pool. With 70% of the raise in the pool, a sold-out sale uses about 203,400 of the reserve at any price, so almost nothing is burned. An undersold sale burns the unsold part and the unused reserve.
launch._lpBps: 70% of the raise (after the 1.5% launch fee) into the pool, locked forever; 30% to Cloak's treasury for buybacks. Deeper than the usual 50% because GLOAK can't be traded anywhere else. DECIDE.
launch._prices: 0.0002 to 0.01 HYPE per GLOAK in 256 levels (steps of about 0.0000384 HYPE). Sold out at the lowest price: 59 HYPE raised, about 41 HYPE in the pool, all GLOAK worth about 100 HYPE. At the top: 2,950 HYPE raised, about 2,034 HYPE in the pool, all GLOAK worth about 5,000 HYPE. DECIDE: this sets the valuation range.
launch.commitEnd: FILL IN: when bidding closes, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00Z. The owner wallet's door call must land before it.
launch._reveal: The keeper opens every sealed bid with the drand time-lock key just after bidding closes; 30 minutes is plenty. Trading starts when it ends and the launch settles.
